summary.text: Sam Berger is the Democratic and Conservative Party incumbent for NY State Assembly District 27 in Queens. A St. John's University School of Law graduate and attorney, he was first elected in a September 2023 special election to succeed Daniel Rosenthal, who had resigned. He serves on the Aging, Judiciary, Insurance, Mental Health, Social Services and Veterans' Affairs committees and is unopposed for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to his official Assembly biography, he is a lifelong resident of the district, an attorney and community advocate, and a father of three; the Queens Chronicle described him in 2023 as a Kew Gardens Hills native.
Earned a bachelor's degree and a law degree from St. John's University; his Assembly biography identifies him as a graduate of St. John's University School of Law.
Gained legal experience through externships with the Kings County Surrogate's Court and the Queens County Supreme Court, Criminal Term.
In 2023, ran in the special election to fill the Assembly seat vacated when Democrat Daniel Rosenthal resigned to take a job at UJA-Federation; Rosenthal endorsed him.
Won the September 12, 2023 special election over Republican David Hirsch, about 55% to 44% in the Queens Daily Eagle's report, and assumed office on September 14, 2023.
Won a full term in the 2024 general election; in 2026 he advanced from the Democratic and Conservative Party primaries without appearing on the ballot.
Serves on the Aging, Judiciary, Insurance, Mental Health, Social Services and Veterans' Affairs committees and the Asian Pacific American Task Force, per his Assembly committee page.
His Assembly biography states that, since taking office, he has prioritized securing local initiatives for the district, and describes him as the youngest member of the Assembly.

His Assembly sponsor page lists dozens of bills he is prime sponsor of in the 2025-2026 term, including A02139, the "Honoring Our Pledge to Eliminate Antisemitism (HOPE) act," and A04020, a tax credit for installing fire sprinkler systems.

sources.title: Berger aims to fill Rosenthal's shoes
Democrat Sam Berger wins Queens Assembly special election
